notes.title: Playtest for Demo coming soon!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hey everyone![/b][/p][p][/p][p]I’m really thrilled about the positive reception to the game’s official trailer release, so I wanted to share an update and give you an outlook on what the next months will look like.[/p][p][/p][h2]Road to Demo[/h2][p]The plan is to release a demo in the near future and I’m aiming to have it ready well before the upcoming Next Fest.[/p][p][/p][p]Right now, I already have a working demo version that has gone through many playtest iterations and sessions. [b]A huge thank you to all the playtesters who have supported me during this phase![/b][/p][p][/p][p]This is not a promise. If I see during testing that I cannot wrap up the demo in a satisfying way in time, it will be delayed. Quality comes first.[/p][p][/p][h2]Looking for Playtesters[/h2][p]If you find [i]Engraving[/i] interesting and want to help me answer a few remaining questions I still have, I would love to have you join the next playtest.[/p][p][/p][p]I am preparing it right now, so if you want to take part, the best way is to join my [url="https://discord.raffaelepicca.com"]Discord server[/url] and grab the [b]Engraving Playtest[/b] role by reacting with the 🌲 emoji in the [b]#field-guide[/b] channel.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.raffaelepicca.com" style="button" buttoncolor="#ff0000"]Join Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]I will ping this role in the coming days and start the playtest with more instructions.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for the support!
Raffa[/p]

notes.title: Mystery adventure Engraving has you drawing lovely parchment maps - shame about the horrible forest graveyard
notes.notes:
I have recently moved to an area that’s surrounded by forest, or at least, by swathes of greenery that feel like forests when you’re far enough inside them, even if they don’t meet whatever quantifiable definition is currently in vogue. My dreams are ablaze with scenes of sunlight percolating through shifting layers of beech and oak, with visions of dirt paths winding through bramble. Now, here comes Engraving to transform all those dreams into nightmares.
